page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No marginal notes are legible. Along the right edge there is a strip of the neighbouring page's edge and show-through, which is not transcribed. Running head at top, page number at top left.

main_text.p: Constitutis Legibus, quæ nondum sunt ab-rogatæ : nec à me unquam abrogandæ, ni argumentis melioribus Rationis pariter & Religionis edocear, quàm quæ ἐperà [?] militari depromenda.

Deo eventum relinquo, qui ubi femel opinionum stultitiam, & impotentiam Af-fectuum sustulerit, multifariam potest instillare illas Verae Rationis, & pacificae Prudentiae regulas, quae supernè descendens, ad Dei Gloriam maximè, & Ecclesiae Bonum contendit: quibus me confcientia mea obligat eò curâ impensiori, & sollicito magis zelo attendere, quantò cætera Repu-blicâ Ecclesiam, Christi Gloriam meâ præ-priâ, denique Salutem Animarum, omni Corporum, & Facultatum conservatione duco potiorem.

Nefas interim (meo judicio) & improba. præsumptio, ut ulli omnino mortales, in Ecclesias meæ fidei, & tutelæ con-creditas, Formas has suas & fabricas, suo fictas arbitrio, & ad fines suos accommo-datas vi & armis conentur inducere, nec confensu meo impetratâ, nec vel Mea, vel aliorum confcientiis ullâ vi Rationum expu-gnatis.
Quod ad caeteros Illos Turbidos Motus, qui nec hominem nec Christianum nec fidelem subditum decant, nullius apud me unquam momenti erunt, vel ad confirman-dam

page.notes: Printed "præ-priâ" at a line break is copied as printed; the mark before it is not clear. The Greek word after "quàm quæ" is uncertain and marked [?]. Italic and roman type is partly uncertain in places. The Greek running head is copied as it appears on the scan. A small "*" after the running head is not included.
